correctness.rationale: All legal one-point extensions in the degree-at-most-one age are exhausted by fresh and designated mate types. A globally isolated marked vertex prevents its mate extension, yielding rank 0. Otherwise mate realizations preserve c,d; fresh replies consume a free whole edge (c decreases 1) or use an isolate (creates rank-zero marked position). Uniform induction proves finite rank c+1_{d>0}; infinitely many free edges give an infinite winning strategy and rank infinity. Exponential labelled matching count gives EGF; direct recursive game checker confirmed all 51,883 finite marked positions through 12 vertices and all 3,736 labelled hosts through 9 vertices. The proof, not the bounded checks, establishes all sizes and countable claims.

value.rationale: Finite matchings form a canonical non-free-amalgamation Fraïssé age with a natural homogeneous limit. The result completely determines an emerging ordinal-valued model-theoretic invariant on all countable hosts, proves an explicit failure of the Rank Property, gives a resource interpretation of every marked position, and derives an exact finite labelled rank distribution and unique minimal hosts. It provides a meaningful structural boundary rather than a one-off parameter value or a routine finite table.
